summary: Trivial pointer-initializer helper (__cdecl): writes zero to the dword pointed to by a4 and returns that pointer. Parameters a1, a2 and a3 are accepted but unused; the caller relies on the returned pointer for chaining.

operations.description: Capture the target pointer: result = a4.
Write zero into the dword at *a4.
Return the pointer a4 (via result) after zeroing its target.

unresolved: Why parameters a1, a2 and a3 are passed but unused.
The purpose of the zeroed dword and the identity of the caller's object.
Whether the leading legacy ABI name reflects the intended object lifetime pattern.
